title: DR reflection plan: apm layer (39 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the apm layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

operations.rationale: Remove apm.metricconfiguration.serves.apm.resource: apm.metricconfiguration.depends-on.apm.resource already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.28; claims node:apm.metricconfiguration#5, rel:apm.metricconfiguration#1, rel:apm.metricconfiguration#2.

evidence.quote: The 'serves' relationship from apm.metricconfiguration to apm.resource appears to point in the wrong direction. Proposed: Invert the relationship direction or replace it with a predicate that fits, such as having the configuration reference or use the resource.

The relationship apm.metricconfiguration --serves--> apm.resource is semantically inverted, since the resource is a passive identity input consumed by the MeterProvider rather than a consumer served by it. Proposed: Drop the serves relationship from apm.metricconfiguration to apm.resource.

The relationship apm.metricconfiguration --serves--> apm.resource is redundant with apm.metricconfiguration --depends-on--> apm.resource, as both express the same meaning. Proposed: Remove serves.apm.resource and keep depends-on.apm.resource.

Sorting answers (node:apm.metricconfiguration#5): best source of 'serves apm.resource': none (0.30), apm.metricconfiguration (0.28), apm.instrumentationscope (0.18); best destination of 'apm.metricconfiguration serves': apm.resource (0.41), none (0.33), apm.instrumentationscope (0.09); best predicate: depends-on (0.28), uses (0.24), none (0.18). Outcome: alternative (predicate=depends-on).
